readerQuestionCoverage.item: Can tretinoin fill deep pitted icepick scars?
readerQuestionCoverage.whyThisMatters: Managing expectations prevents users from discarding tretinoin early when deep scars do not fill.
readerQuestionCoverage.finalCopyUse: Explain that tretinoin improves skin reflectivity and softens boxcar edges but cannot fill deep icepick craters.

readerQuestionCoverage.item: How long does it take for tretinoin to fade acne marks?
readerQuestionCoverage.whyThisMatters: Fading post-acne marks (PIH/PIE) requires 3-6 months due to cell turnover speeds.
readerQuestionCoverage.finalCopyUse: Provide a timeline showing 6 months is the minimum duration for deep collagen remodeling.

readerQuestionCoverage.item: Why does tretinoin make my skin peel?
readerQuestionCoverage.whyThisMatters: Peeling is a common side effect of rapid epidermal shedding (retinization).
readerQuestionCoverage.finalCopyUse: Explain the cellular shedding process and introduce the sandwich method to control peeling.

recommendationSanityPlan.whyThisMatters: Prescription warning is legally required for Indian Schedule H drugs.
recommendationSanityPlan.finalCopyUse: Include an explicit dermatologist prescription notice and outline the typical price range.

claimRiskPlan.item: Tretinoin cures all types of acne scars within weeks
claimRiskPlan.whyThisMatters: Overclaiming efficacy destroys credibility and violates medical compliance.
claimRiskPlan.finalCopyUse: Position tretinoin as a slow, steady remodeling active requiring at least 6 months.

troubleshootingPlan.whyThisMatters: Severe skin barrier compromise requires immediate cessation.
troubleshootingPlan.finalCopyUse: Advise pausing tretinoin and applying only basic ceramides until the skin barrier recovers.
